asr.full_text: Hello everyone and welcome back to a new video. Seans the name, YouTubes the game. In this video we'll be talking about how much a single view is worth to a creator on youtube. In this topic most people get it wrong or have no idea what they are talking about, which is why we are talking about it today. And if you are new around here consider smashing that subscribe button, we go over all sorts of behind the scenes data and information related to Youtube on this channel. But without further a due, let's get started. First of all, if you don't know this already, Youtubers do in fact get paid off of their youtube videos. I actually made a video a couple of weeks ago revealing the top 10 richest YouTubers and how much they made. So if you haven't seen that video make sure you check it out at the end of this one. It'll be linked in the description of this video so don't you worry. But yes, YouTubers do in fact get paid off of their YouTube channel. However, it is extremely hard to do because you need to pull in a decent amount of monthly views on your channel. But the question is, how many? How many views, how many likes, how many subscribers, how many comments, how many does it take to actually make a decent amount of money on YouTube and what in particular actually brings home the bacon? Well contrary to popular belief, subscribers mean almost nothing when it comes to getting paid off youtube, its all about the views, which hopefully all of you know that which is why you're watching this video. So youtubers get paid from numerous revenue sources, however we're going to be going over strictly ad revenue today, not youtube ad revenue, donations, sponsorships, merch sales, etc. Just how much money a single view generates a YouTuber when someone watches an ad on their video. Now, people always break it down by how much a YouTuber makes per thousand views. But nah, we're doing it by single view today because it makes much more of an impact on us this way. Now, I've broken this discussion down in so much more detail in my online course to Youtube Success. Here's a snippet of that information. I had a case study where I took monthly ad revenue, from 3 different youtube channels and divided it by the amount of monetised playbacks by the amounts of ads that were played that month. I then took this information of these three channels and average them together. So again, while this number I'm about to give you isn't 100% accurate for every single channel on youtube, it's pretty dang close to what most channels are making. Alright, drum-roll please. I'm about to probably absolutely wow you guys right now because most people don't know what this is and the number's actually extremely low to contrary belief so before I tell you this keep in mind that lots of factors can change this number. Do not forget about that. But on average, when a viewer watches an ad on YouTube keep in mind that lots of factors can change this number. Do not forget about that. But on average, when a viewer watches an ad on youtube, that specific youtube content creator of that video makes a whopping 0.0029 cents. That's literally a ¼ of a penny in USD. Yeah, so like I said, it's super hard to make a living off Youtube because ad rates are not super amazing. But now that you've seen this video, you're probably thinking, Ooh, I know what any Youtuber makes on Youtube. And you're going over to your favourite Youtuber's channel, figuring out how many views they made that month and going, Okay, let's multiply it by 0.0029, and I'll know exactly how much they make. Well, again, that's not quite the case guys, because not all views are monetized, and there's really no way in finding out how many views are monetized on a specific channel. So sadly, you'll have to continue to use socialblade.com for now to find out some information about your favorite YouTubers and again I go into more detail about how I got this number and what factors changed this number and how YouTubers capitalize off this in my course, so if you really want to learn more about YouTube and maybe even start your own successful YouTube channel that actually makes you six figures a year, then check out my website, shawnmalkoo.com. That will also be linked in the description of this video, so don't you worry. But again, I really just hope you guys learned something super cool in this video because I haven't really seen this information, not only at YouTube but the internet in general. This is information I don't really see anywhere else. if you did enjoy this then maybe hit that subscribe button again we've got all sorts of great content that's going to be reaching this channel that i think you'll really enjoy and don't forget to watch that video about the top 10 richest youtubers in 2017 it's pretty eye-opening but again sean's the name youtube's the game i'll catch you all in the next video!
